title: Observe
description: Request for the `observe` tool (spec section 5.3): read state without advancing time. The response reuses the StepResult Observation shape (step.schema.json#/$defs/response/properties/Observation) with environment-defined sections, including ValidActions (REQ-OBS-01), Alerts (REQ-OBS-02), and Landmarks (REQ-OBS-03, see spatial.schema.json#/$defs/Landmark). `observe` MUST NOT advance simulation time or mutate state.

request.description: Arguments for `observe`. With no Include, returns a compact overview.

AgentId.description: Registered agent ID; MAY be omitted in single-agent sessions

Include.description: Sections to include; dot notation addresses sub-sections (e.g. "entities.buildings"). Conventional names: colonists, resources, entities, terrain, rooms, research, zones, threats, factions, prisoners, traders, power, beds, alerts, actions, map, landmarks

Limit.description: Max items per list-valued section. Environments MUST NOT impose hidden caps that cannot be raised by Limit.

response.description: Observation payload with environment-defined named sections (spec section 6.1). Properties below are the standardized contract sections; all other sections are environment-defined.

ValidActions.description: Action types currently executable, with parameter hints (REQ-OBS-01). Context-dependent actions MUST appear only when valid.

Landmarks.description: Stable spatial references usable as anchors (REQ-SPA-04); required when the manifest declares SpatialIntent: true. Ordered by relevance; count governed only by Limit.

valid_action.description: One currently-executable action with parameter hints

Params.description: Parameter hints: parameter name to a type-hint string (e.g. 'anchor') or an array of currently-valid values (e.g. ["Lizzie", "Fox"])

Severity.description: Alert severity: 0 = info, 1 = low, 2 = warning, 3 = critical

Subject.description: Entity the alert concerns (e.g. a colonist name)
